title: Inside vLLM: Anatomy of a High-Throughput LLM Inference System (2025)
summary: A comprehensive technical breakdown of vLLM's internal architecture, exploring its high-throughput LLM inference mechanisms including PagedAttention, continuous batching, and KV cache management strategies that enable efficient GPU utilization during language model serving.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of achieving high-throughput and memory-efficient LLM inference at scale by optimizing GPU resource utilization during token generation.
why_valuable: Provides deep technical insights into production-grade LLM serving infrastructure, enabling developers and ML engineers to understand and optimize their inference deployments.
